generator.meta_title: AI Car Wrap Generator Online | Create & Preview Wraps
generator.meta_description: Bring your wrap ideas to life with the AI car wrap generator. Create unique designs from a prompt or reference image, preview in 3D, and download your artwork.
generator.title: AI Car Wrap Generator
generator.lead: Turn a color palette, a pattern or a visual idea into a vehicle wrap concept with the AI car wrap generator. Choose an available model, describe the look, and add a reference image for inspiration. Explore your design on the car in 3D, then download the PNG artwork when you find a look you love.
generator.notice: The image is a design concept, not a print-ready file. An installer still needs to check seams, panel direction, bleed, and the measured vehicle.
generator.prompt_placeholder:
What should your wrap look like?
Try midnight blue waves with electric cyan accents.
generator.chip_ocean_prompt: Midnight blue waves with electric cyan accents flowing across the doors.
generator.chip_racing_prompt: A dark racing livery with one bright stripe and clean flow from panel to panel.
generator.chip_contours_prompt: Soft contour lines that follow the body and stay quiet near the glass.
generator.reference_help: Add an image to guide the style and artwork.

generator.how_title: How to Use the AI Car Wrap Generator
generator.how_p1: Choose a vehicle from the current library before you write the prompt. The selected body determines the matching template used for your wrap texture. Model years and trims can have different panel layouts, so choose the closest available version carefully. If your vehicle is not listed, use an available model to explore the style, but wait for a matching template before treating the result as a fit for your car.
generator.how_p2: Describe the main color, the pattern and the overall mood in a short prompt of up to 300 characters. You can also select preferred colors or choose an inspiration preset as a starting point. Be specific about which detail matters most: a broad stripe, a flowing illustration or a restrained two-color composition. One request generates one image, making it easier to compare a clear idea before trying another direction.
generator.how_p3: Add an optional JPEG, PNG or WebP reference image up to 5 MB when words alone do not explain the look. Use the reference to communicate a palette, texture or illustration style, and describe what you want to change. Sign in and confirm that you have enough credits before generating. When the result is ready, switch between the image and 3D preview, then download the PNG or open it in the editor.
generator.returns_p1: The AI car wrap generator produces a square PNG texture for the selected vehicle template. You can view the complete artwork, preview it on the matching 3D body and download the image. This gives you a practical way to compare colors and graphic directions without relying only on a picture of a parked car. The image is useful as concept artwork and as a starting point for a conversation with a wrap shop.
generator.returns_p2: The generated artwork is one flat image. Letters, logos and illustrations inside it cannot be selected, rewritten or moved independently. Opening it in the editor does not turn those pixels into editable objects. You can add your own text, uploaded images and shapes as new layers and adjust those layers separately. If the original image contains unwanted lettering, change the prompt and generate another version or process the image in an external image editor.
generator.production_title: Compare the Wrap Concept in 3D Before Printing
generator.production_p1: Look at the front, sides and rear rather than accepting the first attractive flat texture. A line can disappear into a wheel arch, a busy pattern can become difficult to read, and a graphic can break at a door edge. The AI car wrap generator preview helps you compare those visible differences. If the generated composition does not work, adjust the prompt and create a new image; move individual elements only when they are layers you added yourself.
generator.production_p2: You can compare gloss, satin, matte, metallic and pearlescent finishes in the vehicle preview. A finish changes how reflections affect the artwork, while the PNG remains the design image. Treat these presets as a way to explore surface appearance. They do not specify a particular vinyl brand or guarantee printed color. For a physical wrap, compare real film samples and ask the installer to review the artwork on the actual vehicle.
generator.production_p3: Before printing, a professional shop still needs to check measurements, seams, bleed, panel direction, resolution and color. Share the PNG and preview images to explain the look you want, then agree on a production layout with the people fitting the film. A square digital texture is not a measured cutting pattern or a ready-to-install file. This tool helps you choose a design direction; physical preparation happens after the concept is approved.
generator.scope_title: Write a Clear Prompt for Your AI Car Wrap Generator
generator.scope_p1: Start with a main color, add one supporting color, and name a pattern or visual theme. Then say whether the result should feel subtle, playful or bold. For example: “Midnight blue base, electric cyan contour lines, a calm geometric pattern, generous dark space, no lettering or logos.” Use the limited prompt space for visible design choices instead of a long story. Begin with a simple direction, review it, and change one main detail for the next version.
generator.scope_p2: Keep exact names, slogans, registration numbers and business logos out of the generated artwork when accuracy matters. Ask for a concept without lettering, then create your wording with the manual text tool or upload the logo as a separate image layer. These new layers can be positioned and resized; they do not erase marks already inside the AI image. Check your own lettering in the 3D view to see whether it stays readable around panel edges.
generator.scope_p3: When you upload a reference, explain what should carry over and what should change. “Use the warm palette, but replace the dense floral pattern with large abstract shapes” is more useful than asking for an exact copy. A reference guides the overall direction rather than guaranteeing identical artwork or precise placement. Use images you have permission to upload, especially for business projects, and keep your most important composition request easy to identify.
generator.next_title: From an AI Wrap Idea to Your Next Step
generator.next_p1: Browse the community gallery when you want to compare examples before writing a prompt. The AI car wrap generator works with the vehicles currently listed in its selector, and more brands are planned. The current selection includes Tesla Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Model S and Model X configurations. Check the exact year and trim available rather than assuming every version of a model has the same template.
generator.next_p2: If you prefer direct control, open the free browser editor and build a composition with your own layers. If you want a new visual direction, return to the generator with a revised prompt. Credit packs are listed on the pricing page. Before submitting, check the “Open to gallery” setting: unpaid accounts use gallery sharing, while accounts that have purchased a credit pack can turn it off. Shared work becomes public only after approval.
generator.faq_1_q: What does the AI car wrap generator make?
generator.faq_1_a: It creates a square PNG wrap texture based on your prompt, optional reference image and selected vehicle. You can download the artwork and view it on the matching 3D body. The result is concept artwork rather than a measured physical installation file. Use the image to compare a visual direction, then ask a professional wrap shop to prepare the final production layout.
generator.faq_2_q: Can I generate a wrap from a reference image?
generator.faq_2_a: Yes. Add a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB and write a prompt describing the result you want. Explain whether the reference should guide the colors, pattern or illustration style. It helps communicate an idea but does not guarantee an exact copy or fixed placement of every detail. You can also generate from text alone if you have a clear palette and theme.
generator.faq_3_q: Is the generated PNG ready for a print shop?
generator.faq_3_a: Use it to explain the design concept, then let the shop check the actual vehicle dimensions and production requirements. A square texture does not include measured panel outlines, bleed or cutting paths. Print resolution and color also need review before film is produced. Showing both the PNG and the 3D preview gives the installer more context than sharing only a short written description.
generator.faq_4_a: Use a model currently available in the vehicle selector. The library includes Tesla Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Model S and Model X configurations, with different years and trims where listed. More brands are planned. Choose the exact available version for your project; an image made for one template is not automatically a fit for another body. Missing models should not be treated as supported.
generator.faq_5_q: Is AI generation free, and what happens if it fails?
generator.faq_5_a: The browser editor and 3D preview are free to open; AI generation uses 10 credits per image. Credits are reserved when the job begins, charged on success and released if it fails. If a successful image does not match your taste, revise the prompt and generate again using credits. The pricing page lists the available packs, and the generate button shows the cost before you submit.
generator.faq_6_q: Will my generated wrap be visible in the gallery?
generator.faq_6_a: Check the “Open to gallery” setting before generating. Accounts that have not purchased a credit pack use gallery sharing by default. After purchasing a pack, you can turn sharing off for a new generation. Work shared to the gallery enters moderation and becomes public only after approval. Downloading an image does not override the sharing choice, so decide how you want to use the result before you submit.
generator.faq_7_q: Can I edit text, logos or graphics after generation?
generator.faq_7_a: The AI result is a single image, so lettering, logos and graphics inside it cannot be selected or changed independently. You can generate a different image with a revised prompt. In the manual editor, text you create and images or shapes you add as separate layers can be moved, resized and arranged. Adding a new layer does not remove or replace pixels already embedded in the generated picture.
generator.faq_8_q: How is this different from generating a photo of a wrapped car?
generator.faq_8_a: A generated car photograph shows one view of an imagined scene. This tool produces the wrap artwork itself for the selected body, so you can inspect the full texture and preview it from different vehicle angles. That workflow is useful for comparing composition before discussing film with a shop. It still requires a matching template and professional preparation before the concept becomes a physical wrap.

generator.styles_title: Wrap Styles to Explore with AI
generator.styles_description: Give the AI car wrap generator one visual direction at a time. These three approaches can help you choose a palette and a pattern before refining your prompt. Compare the artwork on the selected vehicle, then use the manual editor for any separately added wording or logo placement.

finishes.title: Solid colors, from gloss to pearlescent
finishes.description: A simple color can change the character of a car wrap design. Try gloss for crisp reflections, satin for a softer sheen, or matte for a quieter surface. Metallic and pearlescent presets offer other ways to explore the same palette. These are digital previews of surface appearance, so compare physical film samples before choosing a material for your car.

patterns.title: Racing stripes and geometric graphics
patterns.description: Follow the body lines with a racing stripe, build contrast with angular blocks, or try a repeating geometric pattern. Start with a clear color palette and give the main graphic room to breathe. In the manual editor, arrange your own shapes and uploaded artwork as separate layers. Rotate the preview to see how the composition continues across doors, wheel arches and the rear.

custom.title: Illustrated customs and brand concepts
custom.description: Use illustrations, abstract art or a business color scheme to explore a more personal look. Upload a logo as its own image layer and add important wording with the text tool when you need control over placement. AI can suggest an overall visual direction, but any lettering or logo baked into its generated image stays part of that image. Choose assets you have permission to use.
